contract: Original8-bit Y/Cb/Cr native grids and decoder padding, stored orientation, exact declared fragment/restart contribution; no implicit RGB/luminance/chroma expansion

reference_library.version:
LIBTIFF, Version 4.7.2
Copyright (c) 1988-1996 Sam Leffler
Copyright (c) 1991-1996 Silicon Graphics, Inc.

lzw_reference.policy: decode complete raw LZW payload, retaining full final-strip padding rather than libtiff logical-row clipping

modern_jpeg_reference.policy: aligned original JPEG chunks, explicit YCbCr output with nearest replication; exact inverse decimation recovers source chroma grids. LibTIFF RAW can return partially zero-filled modern JPEG units and is not used for compression7.

qualifications: Native libjpeg warnings fail; limited entropy slack before EOI may be absorbed by mature bit lookahead without warning; no complete semantic entropy proof
Multi-across fragmented tile grids require explicit source SOF; ambiguous table-only stacked geometry is rejected
No planar separate, nonbaseline, higher precision, arbitrary intra-fragment restart declarations or split headers extending beyond first fragment

records.input_condition: independently qualified original-JPEG legacy profile; TIFF6 restart conventions are ambiguous

fabio.classification: versioned display/luminance output; not commensurate with raw component grids
